description:
Delete the compatibility path that converts the pinned shipped-v1 applied-profile record, and every mechanism that exists only to serve it.

## Background

The boundary was built to carry a released v1.0 record shape into the lifecycle's canonical record. Pulling this epic into v1.0 (`@/charter/D-8`) removes the thing it bridged: v1.0 has not shipped, so no released record format exists to stay compatible with, and the boundary is compatibility code for a format no adopter holds.

The project's cutover invariant permits compatibility only inside a named, versioned migration boundary with a tracked removal condition (`@/invariant/canonical-cutover`). That removal condition is now met, so the boundary is removed rather than generalized. A repository holding a pre-release record re-derives its package through capture (`6a479c58`).

The surface is 126 references across seven files: `repository_state/shipped_v1_record.rs` and its pinned evidence fixture, plus call sites in `repository_state/{mod,initialize,materialize,profile_apply}.rs` and `commands/{init,profile}.rs`.

Removing the conversion counter this boundary maintains also dissolves `7793b8b7`, whose order-dependent test asserts on that process-global.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The shipped-v1 record decoder, its conversion, its pinned evidence fixture, and its authentication path are gone, and no call site retains a branch for a pre-canonical record shape.
- [hard] REQ-02: The applied-record reader accepts the canonical record only; a record it cannot decode is a typed error naming the record and its profile, not a silent migration or a fallback.
- [hard] REQ-03: The multi-phase capture that exists solely to authenticate the pinned historical image before planning is removed with it, so a lifecycle mutation captures what its own operation needs and nothing more.
- [hard] REQ-04: No process-global conversion counter survives, and no test depends on one.
- [hard] REQ-05: Every documentation statement describing a migration of a prior record format is removed or corrected in the same change.
title: Remove the shipped-v1 record migration boundary
